justification: The agent correctly identifies the product details (450 THB, 8 units available, refrigerated, 7-day shelf life), both suppliers (SUP-001 at 280 THB and SUP-004 at 270 THB), and the stock shortfall. However, it completely omits the critical fact that PO-008 (150 units from SUP-001) is already in transit with an expected arrival of 2026-02-18, which fundamentally changes the diagnosis — an emergency PO may not be necessary since inbound stock already exceeds active demand.

SUP-001 at 280 THB unit cost (170 THB margin)
SUP-004 at 270 THB unit cost (180 THB margin)
Active demand exceeds available stock (67 units demanded vs 8 available)
